about: Keyboard basics (PLAN 8.1): 3 short steps on the real keyboard. Each task has a check (drill). All texts are Level 1 texts (PLAN 7.4 Rule 6).

steps.title: Find your way
text: The black keys come in groups of 2 and 3.
The white key just left of each group of 2 black keys is C.
Keys on the left sound lower. Keys on the right sound higher.

tasks.text: Press every C on your keyboard. Your keyboard has 6 Cs. Each C is just left of a group of 2 black keys.
Press middle C. Middle C is the C near the middle of the keyboard, just left of the 2 black keys in the middle.
Press a black key in a group of 3 black keys.

steps.title: Fingers and hand shape
text: Your thumb is finger 1. Your little finger is finger 5. This is the same on both hands.
Curve your fingers a little, as if you hold a ball. Keep your wrist loose.
Sit in front of the middle of the keyboard.

tasks.text: Put your right thumb on [[middle_c]]. Press [[middle_c]] with finger 1.
Keep your right hand on [[middle_c]]. Put one finger on each white key. Look at the [[finger_number]] below. Press the key under that finger.
Now use your left hand. Put your left little finger on the C left of [[middle_c]]. Put one finger on each white key. Press the key under each [[finger_number]].

steps.title: Read the screen
text: A note falls down to the line above the keys. When the note touches the line, press its key.
A long note means: hold the key down until the note goes past the line.
Blue notes are for the right hand. Green notes are for the left hand.

tasks.text: Play 10 notes with your right hand. The song waits for you at each key. Press each key when its note touches the line.
Press a key gently 2 times, for a soft sound. Then press a key hard 2 times, for a loud sound.
